# NoTouchWeb

> NoTouchWeb is a browser-based gesture control interface for navigating digital content without touching a mouse, keyboard, or screen.

- Canonical website: https://notouchweb.com/
- Product category: Touch-free web navigation
- Current availability: Interactive browser demo
- Input: Natural hand movement detected by a device camera
- Processing: Local, in-browser motion analysis
- Language: English

## What it does

NoTouchWeb is designed to map natural hand gestures to simple web actions such as advancing an on-screen guide or presentation. The current public demo uses a hand wave to move through a coffee-brewing guide.

## Privacy

In the current demo, camera frames are analyzed locally in the browser. Video is not uploaded, recorded, or stored. Camera access requires explicit user permission.

## Hardware and browser requirements

No dedicated gesture-control hardware is required. The demo needs a modern browser, HTTPS, and a camera already connected to the device.

## Intended use cases

- Moving through recipes while hands are busy
- Advancing presentations while maintaining eye contact
- Exploring touch-free controls for public interfaces
